# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We currently provide security updates for the `main` branch and the latest release.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please do not disclose it publicly. 

Instead, please send an email to the project maintainers or open a private security advisory on GitHub.

We will review all reports and provide an initial response within 48 hours. If the vulnerability is confirmed, we will work on a patch and release an update as soon as possible.
